notes: NFT marketplace, ERC-721 only. Source: contracts/src/market/FlizyMarketplace.sol.
FEE_BPS is a constant (2%). The owner can change feeRecipient and pause new trades, never the fee.
Web reads CHAIN_GIWA_SEPOLIA_MARKETPLACE and CHAIN_GIWA_SEPOLIA_MARKETPLACE_FROM_BLOCK (deployBlock above).

Listings need per-token approval (approve), which every transfer clears, so a listing ends when the NFT leaves the wallet. A listing caps the royalty at the rate in force when it was made; acceptOffer takes the seller's maximum royalty rate.
Superseded: 0xB7d06801Cd089A8ba128fab5F28536547B58B5BB (block 37601187), an earlier build without those two protections. It never traded and is paused.

feeRouter source diverged from the deployed bytecode on 2026-09-22: addLiquidityETH now refunds this call's unused amounts instead of the contract's whole balance. The live address still runs the earlier build, so the verified source on the explorer matches the deployment and not the repo. Redeploy and reverify before relying on addLiquidityETH refunds. Swap paths are unaffected.
FLZ is a testnet demo token: 100000 supply, symbol FLZ, 18 decimals.
Protocol fee default 30 bps (0.30%), hard max 100 bps, paid to treasury.

treasury moved off the deploy-time address on 2026-09-18 via feeRouter.setTreasury, so swap fee income is separable from the ops wallet that pays gas. verification.constructorArgs records the deploy-time value and does not change.
The factory feeTo (Uniswap V2 LP cut) is a separate sink. setTreasury does not affect it.
Swaps go through feeRouter. Liquidity can use feeRouter.addLiquidityETH or V2 router.
Uniswap V2 style 0.30% pool fee remains on the pair (standard V2).
All six contracts are source verified on the explorer (full match).
This V2 port builds on Solidity 0.8.24, not the canonical 0.5.16 / 0.6.6 split.
The FLZ/WETH pair was created by the factory via CREATE2 and was verified directly at its own address (UniswapV2Pair takes no constructor args).
Flizy Mint. Sources: contracts/src/mint/ (FlizyDrop, FlizyCollectionFactory, FlizyCollection, IFlizyMintable). Script: contracts/script/DeployMint.s.sol.
FEE_BPS is a constant (2%) on paid mints; free mints take no fee. The owner can change feeRecipient and pause new mints, never the fee.
Native collections: supply chosen by the creator, at most MAX_SUPPLY_CAP = 10,000; FlizyDrop is their only minter.
Web reads CHAIN_GIWA_SEPOLIA_DROP, CHAIN_GIWA_SEPOLIA_DROP_FROM_BLOCK (drop deployBlock) and CHAIN_GIWA_SEPOLIA_COLLECTION_FACTORY.

The verified FlizyCollection source on the explorer (part of the factory's verification) has one NatSpec comment that the repo has since dropped, on MAX_SUPPLY_CAP. Code is identical; only the solc metadata hash differs.
